text:
Yesterday, I used their services, and the thing that angered me the most was the complete lack of price information. I went in for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal) and inquired about the price. The staff replied with a price range of around 1,000 baht. I then asked about fillings, and they said they would check with the dentist. After that, we made an appointment. On the actual day, which included teeth cleaning, X-rays, and other checks, the bill came to 1800 baht, including a 900 baht deduction for social security, leaving me with a 900 baht difference to pay.
The point that confused me the most was why they didn't inform me of the X-ray or other check-up costs. What if I had only brought money for the teeth cleaning or didn't have social security? Telling me the service fees wouldn't be a secret, but they only revealed it after the procedure. This made me feel very disappointed with the service this time, and I definitely won't recommend this clinic. P.S. The dentist who did the tartar removal was excellent and gave good advice. It's a shame the staff didn't inform me of the prices at all, only answering questions curtly.

text:
My child's permanent tooth was crowding a baby tooth. The solution was extraction, which my child was terrified of. But U Smile Dental Clinic had a great technique for extracting children's teeth. The dentist explained that they would use a strawberry-flavored anesthetic to help the tooth come out. I think it was a topical anesthetic. The rest was the normal procedure: injecting the anesthetic (they asked for a compress to inflate the gums). My child cried "Eeeee!" during the injection.
While waiting for the anesthetic to take effect, they kept talking about the tooth. "Oh, almost came out! I'll put some gauze under it," they said, and then pulled it out. My child closed their eyes and didn't see any scary instruments.

I highly recommend this clinic if you encounter a similar case. My child didn't cry at all; they were completely unaware!

The extraction cost 400 baht.

The clinic has an air filtration system installed, in the context of COVID-19.
They disinfect thoroughly (judging by the smell).

Children's checkups are free if there are no problems.
My child has been seeing this doctor for two years; this was the first time we paid.

For adults, social security insurance is accepted.
